name: Official Pokémon Card Gym Start Lottery

description.text: To mark the start of the season at Japan's Official Pokémon Card Gyms (ポケモンカードジムオフィシャル), game and hobby shops that hosted the card game's local official play from October 2000, each gym held a lottery in 2003 and 2004, whose winners got non-holo promos in new art. The 2004 lottery was the last.

sources.title: Pokumon: Japan Official Pokemon Card Gym Events 2003 - 2007
